verdict.rationale: Orama documents an AnswerSession/answer-engine API that turns queries into conversational answers with sources, built on vector/hybrid search over indexes, plus Orama Cloud's RAG-oriented data sources/projects and MCP server for LLM integration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AnswerSession API itself (only runtime probe covers plain search, not RAG/answer flow) and no OpenAPI/reference spec found for the answer endpoints.
